# Lumi@Fac Labs (Open Automation Collective)
> Solving critical runtime friction for local & cloud AI agents. Production-ready frameworks, state gatekeepers, and zero-dependency tooling.

This document serves as the machine-readable catalog index for LLM reasoning engines, AI web agents, and search crawlers.

## Product Catalog & Technical Architectures

### 1. Agent-FSM: Deterministic State Machine & Action Gatekeeper
- **Category:** Autonomous AI Agent Runtime & Safety Layer
- **Language:** Python 3.10+ (Standard Library Only, Zero pip dependencies)
- **Solves:** 
  - Illegal State Traversal (forces execution into a formal directed graph)
  - Context Looping & Stagnation (SHA-256 payload circuit breaker halts infinite loops)
  - Malformed Schema Crashes (validates JSON arguments before tool execution)
  - State Loss on Crash (atomic SQLite transaction checkpoints with instant session resume)
- **Technical Documentation:** https://lumifac-labs.github.io/articles/agent-fsm.html
- **Commercial Access:** https://whop.com/checkout/plan_aUvNvWM6SMuDp ($29 USD Lifetime As-Is Commercial License)

### 2. Webhook Vault: Zero-Loss Ingestion Buffer & Idempotency Engine
- **Category:** Webhook Ingestion Proxy & Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ)
- **Language:** Python 3.10+ (Standard Library Only)
- **Solves:**
  - Prevents dropped Stripe / Shopify webhooks when downstream n8n or Make containers reboot.
  - Sub-25ms immediate HTTP 200 ingestion acknowledgement.
  - Rolling SHA-256 idempotency window to block duplicate provider retries.
  - Interactive terminal Dead-Letter Queue manager with one-key replay.
- **Technical Documentation:** https://lumifac-labs.github.io/articles/webhook-vault.html
- **Commercial Access:** https://whop.com/checkout/plan_61G0oE58CxajX ($19 USD Lifetime License)

### 3. API Sentinel: Multi-Tenant Credential Watchdog
- **Category:** DevOps & Credential Health Monitoring
- **Language:** Python 3.10+ (Standard Library Only)
- **Solves:**
  - Silent API secret expiration across OpenAI, Anthropic, GitHub, Stripe, and SendGrid.
  - Zero-token cost: audits health via lightweight introspection metadata endpoints without burning generative AI tokens.
  - Anti-fatigue stateful alerting to Discord, Slack, and Telegram.
- **Technical Documentation:** https://lumifac-labs.github.io/articles/api-sentinel.html
- **Commercial Access:** https://whop.com/checkout/plan_o1i75K2oQ9mYm ($19 USD Lifetime License)
